ios_virtual_guest_state_unknown.remedy: Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes.

job_timed_out.cause: A job followed with --wait ran out of its timeout.

launch_failed.remedy: Read the message and the job's log (job.logs); fix the cause and try again.

launch_unmeasured.cause: am start -W reported no TotalTime for this launch.

recording_empty.remedy: Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors.

recording_not_active.cause: No recording runs for this device.

reload_failed.cause: Port … did not answer as an HTTP server.
reload_failed.remedy: Read the message and the job's log (job.logs); fix the cause and try again.

remote_not_found.remedy: remote.list names the configured remotes; add one with remote.configure.

replay_failed.remedy: Fix the cause and replay the rest, or edit the log.

request_cancelled.cause: The MCP client cancelled the request.
request_cancelled.remedy: Nothing to fix; a job the request started keeps running, so check job.list before starting it again.

research_bundle_required.cause: The virtual iOS device or its research engine refused the request or stopped answering.
research_bundle_required.remedy: Prepare a full-system bundle with ios.emulator.prepare_research.

research_environment.cause: The virtual iOS device or its research engine refused the request or stopped answering.
research_environment.remedy: Use ios.emulator.research for this full-system research bundle; it is not a command shell.

research_hardware_missing.remedy: Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes.

research_log_limit.remedy: Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes.

research_serial_failed.remedy: Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes.

research_tools_missing.cause: The virtual iOS device or its research engine refused the request or stopped answering.
research_tools_missing.remedy: Install the iOS research preparation tools.

resource_not_found.cause: No MCP resource has that URI.
resource_not_found.remedy: resources/list and resources/templates/list name the resources this server has.

response_too_large.remedy: Check the session with debug.list and its log; the app must be a debuggable build that is running.

result_not_found.cause: No saved result has this result_id, or it has been removed.
result_not_found.remedy: Run the operation again; large results are saved under the result_id its answer names.

result_too_large.cause: The result is larger than inline_result_kib, so it was saved instead of returned inline.
result_too_large.remedy: Read it in pages with result.read and the result_id from the error.

root_unavailable.cause: The device has no root shell (Google Play images and phones), which the capture needs for tcpdump.
root_unavailable.remedy: Use an emulator with a Google APIs or AOSP image.

run_incomplete.cause: The run has no finished report to add to the history.
run_incomplete.remedy: Wait for the job to end, then record it.

runtime_busy.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

runtime_configuration_conflict.cause: This device already has a native session with different stream settings.
runtime_configuration_conflict.remedy: Reuse the existing session, or stop it before changing stream settings.

runtime_directory.cause: Runtime sockets require an owner-only directory.
runtime_directory.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

runtime_protocol.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

runtime_required.remedy: Start one with runtime.start platform=ios, device and runner_bundle_id, then run the scenario.

runtime_start_failed.cause: A display session with a device did not start or stopped answering.
runtime_start_failed.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

runtime_start_timeout.cause: Native runtime is still starting; inspect runtime.state.
runtime_start_timeout.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

runtime_stopped.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

runtime_timeout.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

runtime_unavailable.cause: A display session with a device did not start or stopped answering.
runtime_unavailable.remedy: Connect the Android runtime before enabling audio.

scenario_failed.cause: One or more device scenarios failed; inspect report.json and screenshots.
scenario_failed.remedy: Read the job's report.json and screenshots for the failing step.

scenario_missing.cause: Something the request names does not exist or is not set up.
scenario_missing.remedy: Save a scenario file in this workspace first.

scrcpy_failed.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

scrcpy_protocol.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

scrcpy_server_missing.cause: The native Android view requires the scrcpy 4.1 server.
scrcpy_server_missing.remedy: Install scrcpy 4.1 or pass the server JAR path to runtime.start.

scrcpy_timeout.cause: Android display server did not connect.
scrcpy_timeout.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

screen_not_found.cause: No screen with this id is in the run being reviewed.
screen_not_found.remedy: List the ids with testing.baselines review.

screenshot_missing.cause: The screenshot the review names is gone from the run directory.
screenshot_missing.remedy: Run the scenario again with record_baselines.

sdk_platform_missing.cause: Something the request names does not exist or is not set up.
sdk_platform_missing.remedy: Install an Android platform with android.sdk_install, then build again.

secret_permissions.cause: The App Store Connect .p8 key must be readable only by its owner.

server_failed.cause: … exited (…) before it listened on port …
server_failed.remedy: Read the message and the job's log (job.logs); fix the cause and try again.

server_timeout.cause: Nothing listened on port … within … s.
server_timeout.remedy: Check that it is still running and reachable, then try once more.

session_job_limit.cause: This MCP session already runs as many jobs as jobs_per_session allows.
session_job_limit.remedy: Wait for a job to end with job.wait, or cancel one with job.cancel.

setting_not_applied.remedy: Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors.

setting_unsupported.cause: Switching airplane mode from adb needs Android 11 (API 30) or newer.
setting_unsupported.remedy: Older Android changes the language only for the whole device, in its Settings app.

setup_failed.remedy: Run tomaccoctl setup from a normal login shell with HOME set.

step_failed.remedy: Read the message and the job's log (job.logs); fix the cause and try again.

step_unsupported.remedy: Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors.

storage_flush_unverified.cause: Engine did not confirm flushing the disposable image.
storage_flush_unverified.remedy: Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes.

store_key_incomplete.cause: key_id, issuer_id and key_path go together.
store_key_incomplete.remedy: Pass key_id, issuer_id and key_path together, or none of them.

store_key_required.cause: An upload needs key_id, issuer_id and key_path.
store_key_required.remedy: Create a team key under Users and Access > Integrations in App Store Connect, and the app record once.

store_request_failed.remedy: Read the HTTP status and Google's message; a 403 usually means the service account lacks permission for the app.

store_response_invalid.cause: Google did not return a bundle version code.
store_response_invalid.remedy: Correct the value the message names; tomaccoctl schema OPERATION lists accepted arguments.

swift_sdk_unconfigured.cause: Swift SDK is not connected to an Android NDK.
swift_sdk_unconfigured.remedy: Run swift.android_configure after installing the matching NDK.

system_packages_missing.remedy: Check the name or path in the message; the matching list operation (device.list, job.list, workspace.list, catalog.list) shows what exists, and doctor what is set up.

temporary_directory_changed.cause: Temporary directory identity changed; preserved replacement.
temporary_directory_changed.remedy: Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors.

terminal_missing.cause: Something the request names does not exist or is not set up.
terminal_missing.remedy: Run xtool auth login in a terminal yourself; only the person signs in.

test_runtime_required.cause: The request was refused; the message says why.
test_runtime_required.remedy: Run portable Swift unit tests on Linux; Android behavior needs a device integration test.

text_requires_accessibility.cause: For non-ASCII text use runtime.input action=fill with the field coordinates; this replaces its full accessible value.
text_requires_accessibility.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

text_too_long.cause: Text through the clipboard is limited to {PASTE_LIMIT} bytes.
text_too_long.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

text_unsupported.cause: Text outside ASCII goes through the device clipboard, which needs the scrcpy 4.1 server.
text_unsupported.remedy: Configure scrcpy with settings.configure, or run testing.setup and use testing.action with fill.

tool_failed.cause: A tool Tomacco ran exited with an error.
tool_failed.remedy: Read the tool's output in the message or the job's log (job.logs) and fix its cause.

tool_missing.cause: A tool the operation needs is not installed or not configured.
tool_missing.remedy: Install it as doctor's next_steps say, or point settings.configure executables at it, then call again.

tool_output.cause: A tool printed something Tomacco could not read.
tool_output.remedy: Run the tool by hand in the project to see its own error; an outdated tool version is a common cause.

tool_start_failed.cause: A tool could not be started.
tool_start_failed.remedy: Check that the configured path is an executable file (settings.get, doctor) and that the host has the libraries it needs.

tool_timeout.cause: A tool Tomacco ran did not finish in its time.
tool_timeout.remedy: Check that the device or network it needs is reachable, then try again; a job's timeout argument can give it longer.

toolkit_missing.cause: The pinned omarchy-apple-dev checkout has no …
toolkit_missing.remedy: Check the name or path in the message; the matching list operation (device.list, job.list, workspace.list, catalog.list) shows what exists, and doctor what is set up.

toolkit_sdk_missing.cause: The private toolchain has no current SDK. An SDK from ios.sdk_install does not count: the pinned xtool fork refuses its older stamp.
toolkit_sdk_missing.remedy: Check the name or path in the message; the matching list operation (device.list, job.list, workspace.list, catalog.list) shows what exists, and doctor what is set up.

toolkit_toolchain_missing.cause: The private omarchy-apple-dev toolchain is not installed.
toolkit_toolchain_missing.remedy: Check the name or path in the message; the matching list operation (device.list, job.list, workspace.list, catalog.list) shows what exists, and doctor what is set up.

trace_output.remedy: Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors.

transport_failed.cause: The MCP server could not write to its client.
transport_failed.remedy: Restart the client's connection to tomaccoctl mcp.

ui_hierarchy_unavailable.cause: … needs a UI hierarchy, and the virtual iPhone's guest tools do not report one.
ui_hierarchy_unavailable.remedy: Use testing.run with tap, swipe, text, key, wait_screen and assert_screen steps, or ios.emulator.control with coordinates.

uninstall_installer_missing.cause: … is missing: installations made by {PRODUCT_NAME} 1.0.0 do not keep it.
uninstall_installer_missing.remedy: Download the release package and run python3 install.py --uninstall from it.

uninstall_python_missing.cause: Uninstalling needs Python 3, which the installer runs on.

unsafe_data_directory.cause: The Tomacco data directory is not a directory owned by this user: …
unsafe_data_directory.remedy: Set TOMACCO_HOME to a directory you own.

unsafe_runtime_directory.cause: Runtime directory is not a private directory of this user: …
unsafe_runtime_directory.remedy: Remove it, or set TMPDIR to a directory only you can write.

unsigned_artifact.cause: Bundle signature could not be verified.
unsigned_artifact.remedy: Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors.

unsupported_artifact.cause: The input is of a kind this operation does not support.

unsupported_boot_display.cause: This engine does not provide the guest boot framebuffer; rebuild the SPTM engine with Tomacco's patch.
unsupported_boot_display.remedy: Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes.

unsupported_boot_media.cause: This engine cannot register the RAM image with IOMedia; rebuild the SPTM engine with Tomacco's patch.
unsupported_boot_media.remedy: Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes.

unsupported_codec.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

unsupported_engine.cause: Guest commands require the Darwin/SPTM restore-shell backend.
unsupported_engine.remedy: Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes.

unsupported_firmware.cause: No matching board/variant erase identity in the firmware.
unsupported_firmware.remedy: Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes.

unsupported_image.cause: The input is of a kind this operation does not support.
unsupported_image.remedy: Pass one of the supported kinds the message or the operation's schema names.

unsupported_input.cause: This action is not supported by the Android runtime.
unsupported_input.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

unsupported_key.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

unsupported_native_arch.cause: The ELF architecture is not supported by the Android NDK debugger.
unsupported_native_arch.remedy: Check the session with debug.list and its log; the app must be a debuggable build that is running.

unsupported_step.cause: … is not available on the virtual iPhone.
unsupported_step.remedy: Pass one of the supported kinds the message or the operation's schema names.

unsupported_working_image.cause: Working images require boot_media=true and an engine providing boot-storage.
unsupported_working_image.remedy: Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes.

update_auto_off.cause: Updates are not set to install by themselves.
update_auto_off.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

update_busy.cause: An update is being installed right now.
update_busy.remedy: Wait for the running installation to end; update.status shows it.

update_check_failed.cause: Checking for, downloading or installing an update did not work.
update_check_failed.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

update_checksum_mismatch.cause: Refused the update: the package does not match its published checksum. Nothing was installed.
update_checksum_mismatch.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

update_download_failed.cause: Downloading … failed: GitHub answered with status ….
update_download_failed.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

update_forced_off.cause: Checking for, downloading or installing an update did not work.
update_forced_off.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

update_health_check_failed.cause: Checking for, downloading or installing an update did not work.
update_health_check_failed.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

update_held.cause: This version failed to install or was rolled back, so it is not installed by itself again.
update_held.remedy: Install it with update.apply manual:true only if the person wants to try it again.

update_install_failed.cause: The installer reported no journal for this installation.
update_install_failed.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

update_installer_failed.cause: Checking for, downloading or installing an update did not work.
update_installer_failed.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

update_invalid_package.cause: Refused the update: …. Nothing was installed.
update_invalid_package.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

update_no_package.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

update_no_release.remedy: Nothing to do until a release is published.

update_not_available.cause: No newer version is known yet.
update_not_available.remedy: Nothing to do: this is the newest known version.

update_not_newer.cause: Release … is not newer than …; an update never downgrades.
update_not_newer.remedy: Nothing to do: an update never downgrades.

update_nothing_to_roll_back.cause: There is no installed update to roll back.
update_nothing_to_roll_back.remedy: Nothing to do: no update was installed.

update_off.cause: Updates are turned off. Install one from the Settings, or pass manual when the user asked for it.
update_off.remedy: Pass manual:true only when the person asked for this update.

update_offline.cause: GitHub could not be reached during the download. This computer may be offline.
update_offline.remedy: Connect to the network and try again.

update_python_missing.cause: Installing an update needs Python 3.9 or newer, which {PRODUCT_NAME}'s installer runs on. Nothing was changed.

update_rollback_failed.cause: The update failed (…) and restoring the previous version failed too (…). Its files are in the backup ….
update_rollback_failed.remedy: Run the installer with --rollback and this backup ID, or install again.

update_signature_invalid.cause: Refused the update: …. Nothing was installed.
update_signature_invalid.remedy: Correct the value the message names; tomaccoctl schema OPERATION lists accepted arguments.

update_signing_key_missing.cause: This build of {PRODUCT_NAME} has no release signing key, so it cannot verify an update and will not install one.
update_signing_key_missing.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

update_too_large.cause: Refused …: it exceeds the size limit.
update_too_large.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

update_unsafe_package.cause: Refused the update: …. Nothing was installed.
update_unsafe_package.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

update_unsigned.cause: Refused the update: release … has no signature (….sig). Nothing was installed.
update_unsigned.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

update_unwritable.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

update_wrong_host.cause: Refused the download address …: it is not this project's.
update_wrong_host.remedy: Read the message; update.status shows the update state, and Tomacco keeps the installed version when an update is refused.

variable_missing.cause: JDWP expressions support local variables and field paths.
variable_missing.remedy: Check the session with debug.list and its log; the app must be a debuggable build that is running.

variant_required.cause: This app has product flavors; name the build variant to install.
variant_required.remedy: Pass variant with one of the build variants the message lists.

verify_unreadable.remedy: Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors.

version_ambiguous.remedy: Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors.

version_unsupported.cause: Info.plist is not an XML property list.
version_unsupported.remedy: Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors.

video_protocol.remedy: Check with device.list that the device is online, then stop the session with runtime.stop and start it again.

worker_reaper_unavailable.cause: The request was refused; the message says why.
worker_reaper_unavailable.remedy: Read the message, change what it names and try again; docs/troubleshooting.md lists known errors.

worker_start_failed.cause: A step Tomacco ran did not succeed.
worker_start_failed.remedy: Read the message and the job's log (job.logs); fix the cause and try again.

workflow_needs_confirmation.cause: A workflow.run step is destructive or publishes and has no confirm.
workflow_needs_confirmation.remedy: Tell the person what those steps delete, overwrite or publish, and set confirm:true on each only after they agree.

workflow_step_failed.cause: A workflow.run step failed or its job did not succeed; the later steps did not run.
workflow_step_failed.remedy: Read details.steps for that step's error or job, fix the cause and run the workflow again.

workflow_timed_out.cause: workflow.run ran out of its timeout while following a job.
workflow_timed_out.remedy: The job keeps running: follow it with job.wait, or stop it with job.cancel.

working_image_changed.cause: Working image was replaced before the job started.
working_image_changed.remedy: Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes.

working_image_flush_failed.cause: Engine did not confirm flushing the working image.
working_image_flush_failed.remedy: Read the message; ios.virtual.status and the job's log show the device's state, and docs/virtual-ios/troubleshooting.md lists known causes.

workspace_busy.cause: This project already has an active build or app session.
workspace_busy.remedy: Wait for the named job with job.wait, or cancel it with job.cancel if the person agrees; do not work on a copy of the project.

xcode_import_failed.cause: A step Tomacco ran did not succeed.
xcode_import_failed.remedy: Read the message and the job's log (job.logs); fix the cause and try again.

xtool_project_required.remedy: Create one with project.create kind xtool, or use project.import_xcode.
